subset: PUBLIC-LAND plots only (OWNGRPCD 10/20/30; every forest condition public) -- avoids the ~20% private-plot coordinate swap
biomass: FIA precomputed DRYBIO_AG (post-2023 DataMart = NSVB, ~15% > old CRM); no allometry run
agb: Σ(DRYBIO_AG lb · TPA_UNADJ /acre) = lb/acre × 0.00112085 -> Mg/ha, per plot-visit (PLT_CN)
coord_tier: B -- public coords fuzzed up to ~0.8-1.6 km (not swapped for public land). Usable for aggregate/coarse (county/ecoregion/~1 km) validation, NOT 10 m pixels. True coords only via FIA Spatial Data Services (paused).
